relevance_note: Case report of one patient with a clinical diagnosis of Tangier disease ("a 62 year old man with Tangier disease"); no ABCA1 variant is reported (pre-gene-discovery paper).
method_note: Transcribed by hand into a small Python script. Single patient, labelled 'patient' (rule 5). No variant of any gene is printed, so the variants table is empty. cites_prior_report_of_same_patients set true because the case history (nose/earlobe enlargement, HDL and apo A-I values) carries citation 14 (Frohlich 1987, 'a new patient with Tangier disease'); the paper does not say in words that the patient was described before. Age at diagnosis not recorded: the paper says he presented to lipid specialists aged 56 and mentions 'late presentation and diagnosis' but gives no explicit diagnosis age. Age at last evaluation left not reported (corneas taken at death, age 62, recorded as deceased age). Low apo A-I marked observed from apo A-I 27 mg/dl cited as part of severe HDL deficiency; the paper does not call it low in words. 'Relative freedom from premature coronary heart disease' recorded as an excluded feature (hedged wording); checklist coronary artery disease left not reported (narrower/hedged). Splenectomy, cholecystectomy reasons not stated, so splenomegaly/hepatomegaly not reported; 'neurological deficit' not specific enough for peripheral neuropathy. No internal contradictions found.
